description: This file contains assembly code for managing the SRAM clock settings and DRAM size operations for the Realtek RTL838X platform. It includes functions to set DRAM clock rates, switch CPU clock sources, and handle PLL configurations, with conditional compilation based on CONFIG_RTL838X.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_start
methods.description: Label marking the start of DRAM initialization routines.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_set_rate
methods.description: Function to set the DRAM clock rate and switch CPU clock source, involving PLL configuration.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_size
methods.description: Variable indicating the size of DRAM, used as an end marker.
